## Fundamentals #0076: Rocket Lab: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-10 16:41
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-10-0076/


Rocket Lab (RKLB) revenue increased in the third quarter by 72.7% year over year to 267.83 million USD, while earnings per share were −0.12 USD compared to −0.03 USD a year earlier.

### Company guidance

The company expects revenue in the fourth quarter of 2026 in the range of 270.00 million USD – 290.00 million USD. The company forecasts gross margin (GAAP) at 34.0% – 36.0%, and adjusted gross margin at 39.0% – 41.0% in the fourth quarter of 2026. The company forecasts operating expenses (GAAP) in the fourth quarter of 2026 at 162.00 million USD – 168.00 million USD, while adjusted operating expenses are at 136.00 million USD – 142.00 million USD. The company expects net interest income of 45.00 million USD in the fourth quarter of 2026. The company forecasts adjusted EBITDA in the fourth quarter of 2026 at −20.00 million USD – −14.00 million USD.

### What management says

Management emphasized that there is a lack of capacity in the rocket launch market, which was anticipated by the company. According to management, after the fabrication of a new Neutron rocket tank dome, the issue with the faulty component has been resolved, although the tank is awaiting testing. Management emphasized that an exact debut date for the Neutron rocket will not be provided until the tank passes all tests. According to management, with rising demand, higher prices for Electron and HASTE launches should be expected. Management emphasized that the company could have signed more Neutron launch contracts, but decided on higher prices with fewer launches. According to management, negative cash flows will not permanently reverse before the Neutron rocket enters production without the acquired Iridium, and the picture is expected to change after the closing of the acquisition.

## Fundamentals #0075: Take-Two Interactive Software: 2Q2027 results

Date: 2026-11-10 13:50
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-10-0075/


Take-Two Interactive Software (TTWO) revenue fell 15.6% year over year to 1.50 billion USD, and earnings per share was −0.29 USD compared to −0.73 USD a year earlier.

### Quarterly results

Net revenue from the Mobile platform was 731.10 million USD compared to 821.60 million USD a year earlier (−11.0% year over year). Net revenue from the Console platform was 615.40 million USD compared to 720.00 million USD a year earlier (−14.5% year over year). Net revenue from the PC and other platform was 150.50 million USD compared to 232.20 million USD a year earlier (−35.2% year over year).

### Company guidance

The company expects net revenue (GAAP) in the third quarter of fiscal year 2027 in the range of 3.27 billion USD – 3.42 billion USD and for the full fiscal year 2027 in the range of 7.98 billion USD – 8.18 billion USD. The company forecasts operating costs (GAAP) for the third quarter of fiscal year 2027 at 1.162 billion USD – 1.182 billion USD and for the full fiscal year 2027 at 4.078 billion USD – 4.098 billion USD. The company expects net income (GAAP) in the third quarter of fiscal year 2027 in the range of 250.00 million USD – 276.00 million USD and for the full fiscal year 2027 in the range of 109.00 million USD – 142.00 million USD. The company forecasts diluted earnings per share (GAAP) in the third quarter of fiscal year 2027 at 1.30–1.44 USD and for the full fiscal year 2027 at 0.57–0.75 USD. The company expects EBITDA (non-GAAP) in the third quarter of fiscal year 2027 in the range of 651.00 million USD – 698.00 million USD and for the full fiscal year 2027 in the range of 1.024 billion USD – 1.082 billion USD. The company forecasts Net Bookings in the third quarter of fiscal year 2027 in the range of 3.35 billion USD – 3.50 billion USD and for the full fiscal year 2027 in the range of 8.00 billion USD – 8.20 billion USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that they are monitoring the brand recognition and anticipation for the release of GTA VI, which is moving in a positive direction. According to management, direct sales in mobile games have a significant and growing share, which improves margins and profit. Management also emphasized a large opportunity in mobile game advertising, including for brands outside the gaming industry. According to management, in response to the risk of AI-supported piracy, the company is strengthening technical protections and legal actions. Management emphasized that they see no need to change guidance before the release of GTA VI. According to management, sales of the new NBA game should rebound in the second half of the year.

## Log #0223: Gravitational Collapse and the Dyson Sphere Decay

Date: 2026-11-08 09:01
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/posts/log-0223/


**Stardate:** 2026.11.08\
**Systems Status:** External Observation\
**Sector:** Inner Volatility Bands

---

### Weekly Telemetry: Opening and Closing Balance

> *The weekly cycle was characterized by rapid mass decompression and a negative energy balance, leading to a significant reduction in T-Mass of 3.58%. The system transitioned from a state of expansion to a state of rapid contraction under the influence of dominant supply pressure.*

* **Subspace Scanner (Weekly Mass Balance):**
    * *System T-Mass (Open → Close):* **40.17 T → 38.73 trillion USD**
    * *Weekly Mass Delta:* **-1.44 trillion USD (-3.58%)**
    * *Core Density (Heavy Nine):* **68.19% → 66.90%** (Delta: **-1.29 pp**)
    * *Average Action (Periphery Temperature):* **$295.98 → $277.01** (Delta: **-$18.97 | -6.41%**)
    * *Core Composition Fluctuation (>1T):* **Stability (no emergence/collapse)**

* **the NDX Star (Sun — 5 Session Balance):**
    * *Price (Previous Friday Close → Friday Close):* **28389.61 → 26979.68 (-1409.93 pts | -4.97%)**
    * *Weekly Range (Extremes):* **26625.50 — 28801.48 (Amplitude: 2175.98 pts)**
    * *Cumulative Energy Flow (Weekly CVD):* **−23.47 M [sell-off]**

* **the NQ Probe (Mercury — 5 Session Balance):**
    * *Price (Previous Friday Close → Friday Close):* **28534.60 → 27102.75 (-1431.85 pts | -5.02%)**
    * *Weekly Range (Extremes):* **26595.00 — 28937.00 (Amplitude: 2342.00 pts)**
    * *Cumulative Energy Flow (Weekly CVD):* **−143.76 K [panic]**

* **the Dyson Sphere (QQQ) (— 5 Session Balance):**
    * *Price (Previous Friday Close → Friday Close):* **690.59 → 656.19 (-34.40 USD | -4.98%)**
    * *Weekly Range (Extremes):* **647.77 — 700.66 (Amplitude: 52.89 USD)**
    * *Cumulative Population Flow (Weekly CVD):* **−10.57 M [panic]**

* **Background Radiation (TICKQ — Weekly Market Breadth):**
    * *Weekly Average Radiation (TICKQ SMA200):* **+6.59 [demand test]**
    * *Weekly Radiation Range:* **Min -9.38 / Max +18.64**

* **Gravitational Structure (Options — the Dyson Sphere (QQQ)):**
    * *Implied Volatility (IV):* **29.27%** (Weekly Average: **27.41%** | Change from Monday: **+1.56 pp**)
    * *Position Structure (Put/Call OI):* **1.09**

---

### Logbook: Gravitational Collapse and Dyson Sphere Disintegration

**1. Weekly Trajectory and Price Volatility (Session overview Monday–Friday)**
In the studied cycle, a rapid change in object trajectories occurred. the NDX Star transitioned from the 28389.61 level to 26979.68, representing a drop of 1409.93 pts (-4.97%). The amplitude of fluctuations on a weekly scale (2175.98 pts) indicates extreme orbital instability. the NQ Probe showed a higher movement amplitude (2342.00 pts), ending the cycle at 27102.75 (-5.02%). the Dyson Sphere (QQQ) correlated with the central movement, losing 4.98% of its value (from 690.59 to 656.19 USD). The entire system transitioned from a phase of testing upper extremes (High: NDX 28801.48) to deep compression towards local lows (Low: NDX 26625.50).

**2. Energy Balance and Cumulative Fuel (Weekly CVD and Volume)**
The energy balance indicates total dominance of selling forces. Cumulative CVD for NDX amounted to -23.47M, signifying massive liquidity extraction. In the case of the NQ Probe, a state of panic was recorded (CVD: -143.76K), and the QQQ Sphere showed a cumulative flow of aggressive supply at the level of -10.57M. The total fuel balance in this cycle is strongly negative, which prevented the maintenance of previous support levels and led to a rapid outflow of energy from the system.

**3. Mass Evolution, Core Density, and Option Shields**
A significant reduction in the total mass of the system (T-Mass) occurred, from 40.17 T to 38.73 T (-3.58%). Core density (objects >1T) underwent dilution, falling from 68.19% to 66.90%. The average action in the system lost 6.41% of its value ($295.98 → $277.01). Despite mass degradation, the Core composition remained stable without sudden collapses of individual singularities. Implied Volatility (IV) rose to 29.27% (an increase of 1.56 pp from the beginning of the week), which, with Put/Call OI at the 1.09 level, indicates the construction of protective shields in response to increased turbulence. TICKQ radiation (SMA200: +6.59) suggests attempts at local demand testing within the volatility noise.

**Quantum Verdict:**
The system is in a phase of rapid mass decrease. Dominant supply force generated a strong downward vector, which reduced T-Mass and lowered core density. The physics of the system after the cycle close indicates a state of high kinetic energy (volatility) coupled with a lack of fuel for immediate expansion.

**Status:** EXTERNAL OBSERVATION. Shields active.

**End of log.**

Market breadth (TICKQ) at close was 210.00, and the SMA200 average was 18.43. The share of companies above 1 trillion USD in the basket capitalization was 69.02%.

Implied volatility (IV) for options on QQQ was 22.58%, and the put/call ratio was 1.25. Companies AMD, AMGN, ALAB, and DDOG presented financial results and management guidance.

## Fundamentals #0073: Datadog: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-04 16:40
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-04-0073/


Datadog (DDOG) revenue in the third quarter was 1.20 billion USD (+35.2% y/y), and earnings per share (adjusted) reached 0.81 USD (+47.3% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP) was 0.32 USD (+220.0% y/y), while earnings per share (GAAP, basic) was 0.33 USD (+230.0% y/y).

### Company guidance

The company expects revenue in Q4 2026 to be in the range of 1.19 billion USD – 1.20 billion USD, and for the full year 2026 in the range of 4.515 billion USD – 4.525 billion USD. In Q4 2026, adjusted operating income (non-GAAP) is expected to be 280.00 million USD – 290.00 million USD, and adjusted earnings per share (non-GAAP) in the range of 0.69–0.71 USD, with full-year 2026 guidance of 2.73–2.75 USD per share.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that earlier contract renewals by large customers are a positive phenomenon, although they constrain revenue in the short term. According to management, customers outside the AI industry are also implementing AI-based solutions, which translates into higher cloud consumption and promises a long period of growth. Management indicated that the group of customers from the AI industry will expand, which will provide more stable results in the future. According to management, earlier contract renewals result from the rapid growth of these customers' companies, rather than from cost-cutting. Management also noted that the Bits AI assistant is the best-received product debut in the company's history. According to management, customers renewing contracts earlier commit to higher spending in exchange for volume discounts.


---

## Fundamentals #0072: Shopify: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-04 13:41
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-04-0072/


Shopify (SHOP) revenue in Q3 was 3.74 billion USD (+31.6% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP) increased by 80.0% y/y to 0.36 USD.

### Quarterly results

The company's operating income reached 568.00 million USD (+65.6% y/y), while net income was 462.00 million USD (+75.0% y/y).

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that personal AI agents represent an entirely new sales channel that allows merchants to acquire new customers. According to management, purchases made by AI agents are in the early stages, but their growth rate is clearly strong. Management noted that when a customer reaches a store via an AI agent, the company's earnings remain the same as with other methods of reaching a customer. According to management, despite the shift in marketing and infrastructure spending over time, nothing has fundamentally changed in the company's costs and profitability. Management also indicated that the purchase of the shop.com domain is a declaration of more ambitious plans for the Shop app as a shopping destination. According to management, brick-and-mortar sales do not constitute a separate business, but are based on the same platform, catalog, and buyer relationships.

## Fundamentals #0071: Keurig Dr Pepper: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-04 13:40
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-04-0071/


Keurig Dr Pepper (KDP) revenue increased in Q3 by 70.5% year over year to 7.34 billion USD, and earnings per share (GAAP, diluted) increased by 22.4% year over year to 0.60 USD.

### Quarterly results

Operating income was 1.33 billion USD (+34.0% year over year) with net income at 952.00 million USD (+43.8% year over year).

### Company guidance

For 2026, the company expects revenue in the range of 25.90 billion USD – 26.40 billion USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that price reductions and promotions in the single-serve coffee segment are appropriate steps for the business, even though they weigh on some of the profit in the short term. According to management, weaker demand for pods and a larger share of private labels are transitional and cyclical phenomena that may last longer. Management noted that work on the company split is proceeding according to schedule. According to management, the company is optimistic about the energy drink market and highly values its position in this sector.

## Fundamentals #0070: Amgen: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-04 11:58
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-04-0070/


> ⚠️ **ERRATUM (2026-11-04)**  
> **One figure was rounded incorrectly in the last digit.**
>
> **Correction:**
> - Revenue grew 8.5% year over year (not 8.4%).
>
> We corrected this figure in the text; the other figures stay the same.

Amgen (AMGN) revenue in Q3 2026 was 10.37 billion USD (+8.5% year over year), and earnings per share (reported) increased by 19.4% year over year to 7.08 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (reported, basic) reached 7.14 USD (+19.4% year over year).

### Company guidance

For 2026, the company expects revenue in the range of 38.90 billion USD – 39.70 billion USD and earnings per share (GAAP) at the level of 18.34–19.28 USD. The company also forecasts adjusted earnings per share (non-GAAP) in the range of 22.90–23.70 USD and capital expenditures at approximately 2.60 billion USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that the company intends to maintain expenditure discipline so that shareholders also benefit from acquisitions. According to management, following the update of guidelines, physicians will quickly change treatment methods in favor of the drug IMDELLTRA, which works strongly in combination with chemotherapy. Management expressed expectation of similar efficacy in combination with antibody-drug conjugates and noted that the company is confident in its position as a reliable supplier of biosimilars, designing new production capacities for larger quantities of protein. According to management, daxdilimab for discoid lupus erythematosus will be prescribed mainly by dermatologists, an area in which the company possesses experience and appropriate teams.

## Fundamentals #0069: Astera Labs: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-04 11:56
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-04-0069/


Astera Labs (ALAB) revenue increased by 153.7% year over year in Q3 to 584.90 million USD, and earnings per share (reported) increased by 98.0% year over year to 0.99 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (reported, basic) was 1.05 USD, representing a 94.4% year over year increase compared to 0.54 USD the previous year.

### Company guidance

In Q4 2026, the company expects revenue in the range of 730.00 million USD – 750.00 million USD and earnings per share (GAAP) at the level of 1.13–1.17 USD. The company also forecasts gross margin at approximately 72.0% and adjusted earnings per share (non-GAAP) in the range of 1.62–1.66 USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that the business model is generating increasing leverage, as operating costs are growing slower than revenue. According to management, Scorpio X switches are expected to continue recording growth thanks to new customers and platforms. Management indicated that Orion rack solutions are expected to improve margin through software sales and licensing fees. According to management, the transition to optical connectivity increases the company's chances, as it earns significantly more from it than from copper solutions. Management also noted that the new Orion rack is not dependent on a single accelerator supplier.

## Fundamentals #0068: Palantir Technologies: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-04 11:38
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-04-0068/


Palantir Technologies (PLTR) revenue in the third quarter was 2.31 billion USD (+95.9% year over year), and GAAP earnings per share increased to 0.44 USD (+144.4% year over year).

### Quarterly results

GAAP earnings per share was 0.47 USD (+135.0% year over year), while adjusted earnings per share reached the level of 0.44 USD (+109.5% year over year).

### Company guidance

The company expects revenue in Q4 2026 at the level of 2.65 billion USD and for the full year 2026 at the level of 8.53 billion USD. According to guidance, adjusted operating income (non-GAAP) is expected to be 1.64 billion USD in Q4 2026 and 5.25 billion USD for the full year 2026, with adjusted free cash flows (non-GAAP) in the range of 4.80 billion USD – 5.00 billion USD for the full year 2026.

### What management says

Management emphasized that commercial customers are moving from discussions to the pilot and implementation phase significantly faster, with initial contracts being shorter but undergoing significant expansion. According to management, the company cannot keep up with demand, which forces a shift of human resources toward inbound customers due to limited capacity. Management indicated that current results stem to a greater extent from the rapid growth of the entire market than from the company's own effectiveness. According to management, the value of artificial intelligence is being created at the level of processes within an organization, and not just by increasing the efficiency of individual employees. Management also noted that customers using Sovereign AI workshops are implementing solutions with great haste, which, according to management, is only the beginning of this trend.

## Fundamentals #0066: Thomson Reuters: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-04 02:33
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-04-0066/


> ⚠️ **ERRATUM (2026-11-04)**  
> **The post misstated the company's guidance.**
>
> **Correction:**
> - The 9.5% – 10.0% range for 2026 revenue and organic revenue growth is the guidance for the company's three main segments ("Big 3"), not for the whole company.
> - Approximately 42% in the fourth quarter of 2026 is the expected adjusted EBITDA margin, not organic revenue growth; organic revenue growth in the fourth quarter is expected at approximately 8%.
>
> We corrected the guidance section; the quarterly results stay the same.

Thomson Reuters (TRI) revenue grew by 10.6% year over year in the third quarter to 1.83 billion USD, while reported earnings per share fell by 17.0% year over year to 0.78 USD.

### Quarterly results

Adjusted earnings per share grew by 14.1% year over year to a level of 0.81 USD.

### Company guidance

The company forecasts for 2026, excluding the Global Print business, revenue growth of approximately 9.5%, organic revenue growth of 8.5% – 9.0% and an adjusted EBITDA margin of approximately 39%. The company expects organic revenue growth of approximately 8% and an adjusted EBITDA margin of approximately 42% in the fourth quarter of 2026.

### What management says

Management emphasized growing optimism regarding the new CoCounsel Legal tool. According to management, shifting the most burdensome tasks from external AI models to Thomson's own model has allowed for greater speed, accuracy, and cost advantage. Management indicated that cooperation with the Skadden law firm is expected to bring attractive revenue, although the company has not yet estimated it. According to management, the company is consciously increasing investments in new AI tools to accelerate revenue growth next year, and details on this matter will be provided in subsequent quarters. Management noted that the business model based primarily on licensing agreements provides predictability of costs for clients. According to management, the closing of the Weil Gotshal law firm will not have a significant impact on the company's business.

## Fundamentals #0065: Booking: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-04 01:23
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-04-0065/


Booking (BKNG) revenue in the third quarter was 8.89 billion USD (−1.3% y/y), while earnings per share (GAAP) increased by 6.8% y/y to 3.61 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (adjusted) reached 4.66 USD (+17.1% y/y), while operating income was 3.42 billion USD (−1.9% y/y). The company's net income was 2.72 billion USD (−1.1% y/y).

### What management says

Management emphasized that the traffic generated by AI tools is currently small, but the company is capturing most of this traffic, which, given the current dynamics, is an early stage. According to management, collaboration with AI agent creators aims to build economic advantage by diversifying traffic sources. Management noted that in some regions, especially in Europe, regulations may slow the adoption of personal AI agents. According to management, small and medium-sized hotels can count on the company's support, as fees are only collected after the guest's arrival. Management also stated that preliminary bookings for next year look healthy, giving the company confidence in its outlook.

## Fundamentals #0064: Advanced Micro Devices: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-04 00:55
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-04-0064/


Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) revenue increased in the third quarter of 2026 by 44.7% year over year to 13.38 billion USD, and earnings per share (GAAP) increased by 94.7% year over year to 1.46 USD.

### Quarterly results

Gross margin was 54.0% (2.0 pp year over year), while earnings per share (GAAP, diluted) stood at 1.48 USD (94.7% year over year).

### Company guidance

In the fourth quarter of 2026, the company expects revenue in the range of 16.49 billion USD – 17.51 billion USD or approximately 17.00 billion USD, and adjusted gross margin (non-GAAP) is expected to be approximately 55.0%.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that demand exceeds supply, therefore the company is working with suppliers to increase supply. According to management, customer deployments are planned, and the company knows which data centers its accelerators will go to. Management indicated that in the face of rising component costs, these costs are to be shared with customers. According to management, operating costs are expected to grow slower than revenue, which is intended to increase the operating margin. Management anticipates a weaker upcoming year in the personal computer market and is monitoring inventory levels in the distribution channel. According to management, the growth in server processor sales is primarily due to the number of chips and cores sold, rather than higher prices.

## Fundamentals #0063: Apple: 4Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-03 23:42
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-03-0063/


Apple (AAPL) revenue in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026 was 114.48 billion USD (+11.7% year over year), and earnings per share (accounting) increased by 13.5% year over year to 2.10 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (accounting, basic) was 2.11 USD (+14.1% year over year), with operating income at 35.63 billion USD (+9.9% year over year).

### What management says

Management emphasized that Siri AI serves as an assistant whose capabilities will be gradually expanded while maintaining an emphasis on privacy and security. According to management, the iPhone is set to become the user's intelligent personal hub, as it stores the most important data to which even the company does not have access. Management is optimistic about long-term services growth, pointing to the growing number of active devices as the foundation of this process. According to management, rising memory prices are putting pressure on product prices, making programs that facilitate customer purchases important. Management also noted that in subsequent quarters, the benefit from cheaper inventory will decrease in the face of unprecedented memory prices. According to management, production of the new iPhone Duo is growing, however, it is currently difficult to predict when supply will meet demand.

## Fundamentals #0062: Vertex Pharmaceuticals: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-03 13:33
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-03-0062/


Vertex Pharmaceuticals (VRTX) revenue in Q3 increased by 11.8% year over year to 3.44 billion USD, while earnings per share (GAAP, basic) fell by 39.1% year over year to 2.58 USD.

### Company guidance

For the full year 2026, the company expects revenue in the range of 13.15 billion USD – 13.25 billion USD, including "PALSONIFY" sales revenue at a level of 40.00 million USD – 50.00 million USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that contacts with the US regulator regarding povetacept are proceeding as planned and the company is awaiting a decision date. According to management, povetacept has been manufactured by the same manufacturer since the beginning of the studies, which allows for a calm assessment of the application and production issues. Management also pointed to interest from nephrologists in povetacept and the desire to use it once it is approved for marketing. According to management, acting on the cause of kidney disease ensures better effects, which increases confidence in the results of anaxaplin. Management noted that in the case of the pain medication JOURNAVX, it is consciously maintaining a patient support program to acclimate physicians to new habits until full reimbursement is ensured. Regarding cystic fibrosis, management stated that the selection of the best next-generation drug will only occur after the results of all candidates are obtained.

## Fundamentals #0061: Company filings: Lumentum, Marvell Technology, Intuitive Surgical and others; insider transactions

Date: 2026-11-03 10:10
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-03-0061/


> ⚠️ **ERRATUM (2026-11-04)**  
> **Sentences about company filings did not say which company they concerned.**
>
> **Correction:**
> - We added the company names and tickers at the start of these sentences.
>
> The figures and dates stay the same.

## Fundamentals #0060: Exelon: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-02 10:49
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-02-0060/


Exelon (EXC) revenues in the third quarter were 7.32 billion USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP) stood at 0.70 USD, while earnings per share (adjusted) was 0.87 USD.

### Company guidance

The company expects adjusted earnings per share (non-GAAP) – “Adjusted (non-GAAP) operating earnings per share” in FY 2026 to be 2.85–2.91 USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that investors building large facilities, including data centers, are ready to commit financially and are willing to sign transmission security agreements. According to management, energy storage provides a necessary tool in the fight against the crisis of price affordability and supply reliability. Management noted that they only include what is realistic and sustainable in their plans, with a potential upside. According to management, the company supports maintaining the price cap on capacity auctions until better ways to reduce costs are found.


---

## Fundamentals #0059: Amazon.com: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-02 10:42
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-02-0059/


Amazon.com (AMZN) revenues in the third quarter were 201.94 billion USD (12.1% y/y), while earnings per share (GAAP) fell by 3.1% y/y to 1.89 USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP, diluted) was 1.92 USD (−3.0% y/y).

### Company guidance

In the fourth quarter of 2026, the company expects revenues in the range of 240.00 billion USD – 247.00 billion USD, which would mean revenue growth at a level of 12.0% – 16.0%, while operating income in the same period is expected to be 28.50 billion USD – 33.50 billion USD.

### Management commentary

Management emphasized that demand for AWS computing power is so high that customers are utilizing new resources almost as quickly as the company installs them. According to management, the company has very good visibility into AWS demand for the coming years, as large blocks of capacity are reserved well in advance. Management indicated that the rapid growth of AI services is lowering the overall AWS margin, as margins in AI are currently lower than in core cloud services. According to management, AI represents an exceptional, historic opportunity, so the company will continue to invest heavily to remain a leader. Management also mentioned that more and more repetitive tasks in logistics centers will be performed by robots, and new facilities are being designed with a high degree of robotics. According to management, selling their own chips externally generates faster revenue, however, using them in their own cloud brings more total revenue and cash.


---

## Fundamentals #0058: Alnylam Pharmaceuticals: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-02 10:39
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-02-0058/


Alnylam Pharmaceuticals (ALNY) revenues in the third quarter were 1.46 billion USD (+16.7% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP) increased to 15.72 USD (+634.6% y/y).

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP, basic) reached 16.19 USD (+626.0% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) were 16.26 USD (+409.7% y/y).

### Company guidance

The company expects total net product revenues in 2026 to be between 4.70 billion USD and 5.10 billion USD. According to forecasts, net product revenue growth in 2026 at constant exchange rates is expected to be between 57.0% and 70.0%.

### Management commentary

Management admitted that they are not satisfied with the demand growth rate for one of the products, despite a significant increase since its launch. According to management, expectations for nucresiran remain unchanged, both in terms of efficacy in monotherapy and in combination with a stabilizing drug. Management indicated that they are seeking solutions to allow hospitals to maintain treatment profitability despite changes in the reimbursement program. According to management, study timelines have not changed, and in the case of Huntington's disease, the company is employing a distinctive approach that allows for deep gene silencing. Management emphasized that they see great growth opportunities and are investing in expanding the circle of prescribing physicians and developing products beyond the current franchise.

## Fundamentals #0057: Strategy: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-02 10:36
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-02-0057/


Strategy company (MSTR) revenues in the third quarter of 2026 amounted to 125.43 million USD (−2.5% y/y), while net income increased by 601.4% y/y to the level of 19.53 billion USD.

### Quarterly results

Operating income reached 20.91 billion USD (437.4% y/y), and earnings per share (reported) was 44.75 USD (431.5% y/y). Earnings per share (reported, basic) was formed at the level of 47.78 USD (413.8% y/y).

### What management says

Management emphasized that the company currently possesses a large reserve of credit capacity on the balance sheet, which allows for the creation of a large amount of credit. According to management, the most important goal is the return of the Stretch instrument to its nominal value and its development for the purpose of purchasing bitcoins and increasing the value of common shares. Management indicated that the company can currently issue digital credit instruments, whereas previously it relied mainly on convertible bonds. According to management, the entry of large financial institutions validates bitcoin, which reduces the risk for the entire industry. Management also noted that after the disruption of quotes, all of the company's credit instruments recovered losses to a similar extent.

## Fundamentals #0056: Linde: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-02 10:33
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-02-0056/


Linde (LIN) revenues in the third quarter amounted to 9.40 billion USD.

### Quarterly results

Earnings per share (GAAP) reached 3.66 USD, while earnings per share (adjusted) was 4.59 USD.

### Company guidance

The company expects adjusted earnings per share (non-GAAP) in the fourth quarter to be 4.40–4.50 USD (an increase of 5.0% – 7.0%), and for the full year 2026 to be 17.82–17.92 USD (an increase of 8.0% – 9.0%). Capital expenditures for the full year 2026 are expected to range from 5.50 billion USD to 6.00 billion USD.

### Management commentary

According to management, the European market remains stable, but they see no evidence for a return of growth in this region in the near future. Management emphasized that growth in the electronics sector results from organic demand and is confident about this trend in subsequent quarters. In the face of rising inflation, management indicated that price increases worldwide, including in China, remain a key point of focus. Management also noted that in the long term, there will be a helium surplus in the market, therefore the company is exercising caution when setting prices in long-term contracts.

## Fundamentals #0055: DexCom: 3Q2026 results

Date: 2026-11-02 10:23
URL: https://heniu.blog/en/f-log/flog-2026-11-02-0055/


DexCom (DXCM) revenues in the third quarter were 1.34 billion USD (+11.2% y/y), while earnings per share (adjusted) increased by 19.7% y/y to 0.73 USD.

### Quarterly results

The company's operating income reached 327.20 million USD (+34.9% y/y), while net income decreased by 3.1% y/y to 275.10 million USD. Earnings per share (GAAP) stood at 0.72 USD (+2.9% y/y), and earnings per share (GAAP, basic) remained unchanged compared to the previous year, at 0.73 USD (0.0% y/y).

### What management says

Management emphasized that despite market turbulence, the assessment of the company's opportunities remains unchanged, and the long-term plan inspires great confidence. According to management, reimbursement in international markets is maintaining a stable level. Management expects a decision regarding reimbursement for patients with diabetes not treated with insulin later this year. Management indicated that the publication of a study in a prestigious medical journal constitutes breakthrough evidence of the effectiveness of the company's systems, which, according to management, should significantly impact treatment standards. According to management, insurers typically provide equitable access to different systems, as patients, physicians, and employers strive to have a choice.
